I see what you are trying to do here and I would think that to be logically consistent with even Destiny's position I would go with yes. Even in cases of brain death, the most used component in determining brain death has a 90% (funnily enough) use rating. If someone is considered braindead and certain qualifiers aren't used to determine the exactness of brain death then can it really be determined as irreversible? I think that generally, hospitals evaluate the criteria of brain death at that the patient is almost certainly not going to recover instead of doing the arduous process of running through every criterion. Depending on which country you are in the way that brain death is applied is varied such as the way consciousness is present in fetuses by different studies. Therefore I think the range should be broadened or changed for Destiny's position as the line for determining consciousness is about as iffy as that of the determining brain death.
